results.title: Knock on my Tver
results.overview: A lonely farmer from the Tver region, Sergey, is forced to sell part of his holdings due to debts. The buyer turns out to be Alisa, a businesswoman from the capital, for whom this is an easy and profitable deal. Unexpectedly, Sergey refuses Alisa and asks her to leave. Discouraged by such a "warm" welcome, the girl decides to convince Sergey and remains to live in his house. After all, even nature itself helps Alisa, bringing down a hurricane on the farm, blocking all exits. Will a rural handsome man and a metropolitan socialite be able to get along together for at least a couple of days? And at what point will they understand that they are united not only by business, but also by love.

results.title: Shamed
results.overview: An online vigilante, self-described as the "Creeper Hunter," seeks out potential sexual predators and ambushes them in videotaped confrontations, exposing them to the court of public opinion. Ultimately, his actions land him in a legal battle to justify his ethically questionable actions.

results.title: Eighteen
results.overview: It's the day before Grace Fitzgerald's 18th Birthday - aka the last day of her childhood. Desperate to have one last 'golden' day, Grace and her best friend, Bella, skip school to have an adventure.

results.title: Land of Canaan
results.overview: When Dr. Nasser Abufarha, a Palestinian American entrepreneur, returns to the occupied West Bank and finds the olive harvest in crisis, he leads a movement to preserve an ecosystem and thousands of years of ecological knowledge, helping to build one of Palestine's most influential fair-trade networks. In the midst of a genocide and ecocide, where Palestinian land, culture, and livelihood face erasure, Land of Canaan documents a way of life, shows us what is at stake, and why it must be protected.

results.title: Something Real
results.overview: A perfectionist tries to engineer the perfect breakup, but when her carefully laid plans spin wildly out of control, she's forced to confront the beautifully messy reality of love and connection.

results.title: Raju Weds Rambai
results.overview: Raju Weds Rambai is inspired by a real story of a carefree band drummer whose love for a compounders daughter triggers a clash of ego and honour, turning their sweet village romance into an emotional journey filled with conflict, pain, and ultimately redemption.

results.title: কোনো এক বসন্ত বিকেল
results.overview: A young boy finds a bag of jewelry and cash and, teaming up with a girl who isn’t the owner, sets out to uncover who it truly belongs to.

results.title: Queer Me
results.overview: In 2015, Irene, just arrived from Spain, lands at the TDB, a squat in Toulouse occupied by radical queer youth, a refuge in a hostile world. There, she films and shares the euphoria, struggles, loves, and fierce zest for life that drive them. Now, reconnecting with her comrades from that time, she embarks on a joyful journey of self-discovery to shatter the overly narrow norms of our societies.

results.title: A Teenage Tragedy
results.overview: A teenage girl summons a demon to better her life, but it ultimately backfires, throwing her life and the lives of everyone close to her into absolute chaos.

results.title: Unclaimed
results.overview: A woman named Mary wakes up in her home, in a pool of blood and with a knife in her hand. Her husband is missing and Mary has no memory of what happened.

results.title: Before the Lighthouse
results.overview: Exploring the formative figures and defining events of the wind swept island of Chincoteague during a period of rapid change. Set between the late 18th century and the period just before the construction of the lighthouse.
